resource.description: Invalid ECL: a member filter ({{ M ... }}) may only follow a memberOf (^) expression constraint. Here the bracketed disjunction of six memberOf constraints is not itself a memberOf, so the member filter that follows it is a syntax error. The corrected form moves the ^ outside the brackets: ^ ( A OR B ... ) {{ M effectiveTime >= "20250101" }}.
